It's the Club Championship 880 yds of 1946 and the setting is Tooting Bec track. Just look at those crowds; over half the track was lined like that. Taking the lead, which he held to the end, is Len Marchant who won in 1:59.0 from Len Herbert (4th from right) and Jack Brown (6th from right).
